scenarios.title: Current eligibility with Assessment Date changed uses Assessment Date as transaction effective date
gaps: Semantic duplicate: Test Case Id 'TC_002' shares the same business intent as 'TC_001' — both validate that for current eligibility with an Assessment Date change, the transaction effective date in Facets is the Assessment Date. Evidence from Test Case Name field: 'Verify AR PASSE current eligibility with multiple Assessment Date occurrences uses the first Assessment Date as the transaction effective date' and 'Verify AR PASSE current eligibility uses the changed Assessment Date as the transaction effective date'.

scenarios.title: Current eligibility with Assessment Date changed and relevant fields unchanged keeps field values and uses Assessment Date
gaps: TC_001 is the most closely related case, but the scenario description also requires "1) Assessment Date changes while the relevant fields are unchanged. 2) Assessment Number remains unchanged while Assessment Date changes. 3) Assessment Tier remains unchanged while Assessment Date changes. 4) Assessment Division remains unchanged while Assessment Date changes. 5) Aid Category remains unchanged while Assessment Date changes. 6) Rate Cell remains unchanged while Assessment Date changes."; add dedicated test case(s) for the missing quoted condition(s) not covered by the table.
